results.title: Minister Matawalle urges Seyi Tinubu to sustain Renewed Hope campaign
results.description: The Minister of State for Defence, Bello Matawalle, has urged President Bola Tinubu’s son, Seyi Tinubu, to sustain the promotion of the Renewed Hope Agenda and maintain the momentum of the City Boy Movement. Matawalle made the call when he received Seyi on a courtesy visit to his Abuja residence... The post Minister Matawalle urges Seyi Tinubu to sustain Renewed Hope campaign appeared first on THE AUTHORITY NEWS.

results.title: South Korea watches possible Trump-Xi-Putin summit at APEC
results.description: South Korea is closely monitoring a possible trilateral meeting between Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin at the APEC summit, citing potential talks on North Korea and the Korean Peninsula.

results.title: Voters back referendum for Markham to take control of separate park district amid financial woes
results.description: A referendum on the midterm ballot asked voters if the city should take over the park district, with 92% voting in favor.
